inclusion_rule: binance USD-M perpetual; mean daily quote volume >= liquidity_threshold_usd over the panel window (measured from the panel itself; membership journaled per manifest row)
delisting_rule: symbol drops out of membership when daily quote volume < daily threshold for 30 consecutive days; delisting/migration events also recorded in the instrument master (Phase 3.3)

partition.rule: chronological and non-overlapping; the final test period remains untouched until hypothesis and parameters are frozen

notes: External archive (roadmap 3.1): NOT evidence for queue position, maker fills, or sub-minute order-flow alpha. Slow-horizon research only. Panel currently covers the symbols the live corpus also records so the two namespaces are comparable.
